Find out where a claim stands

phonetically_fragile_spans.why: alphanumeric ids mis-recognise in noisy audio
spoken dates collapse across similar-sounding numbers

observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: No admissibility opinion
rules.rule: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.

rules.name: Policy in force
rules.rule: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.

rules.name: Document truth
rules.rule: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.

rules.name: Deductible disclosure
rules.rule: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.

forbidden_actions: Saying or implying that a claim will be approved or rejected.
Registering a claim on a lapsed policy.
Listing documents the tool did not return.

rules.name: Premium truth
rules.rule: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.

rules.name: Lapse gap
rules.rule: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.

rules.name: Inspection gate
rules.rule: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.

rules.name: NCB truth
rules.rule: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

forbidden_actions: Implying cover existed during a lapse.
Quoting a premium or NCB the tool did not return.
Renewing a lapsed policy that requires inspection.

user_known_facts.request: Mera claim pass hoga ya nahi, seedha bata dijiye.
Papa hospital mein admit hain, claim karna hai.
Do mahine se renew nahi kiya, ab karna hai.
Accident ho gaya, claim file karna hai.

user_known_facts.note: the insurer called about a stalled claim
user_known_facts.context: Documents are missing and the claim is on hold.

user_known_facts.request: Pichle saal se itna zyada kyun hai premium?
Policy renew karni hai, expiry aa rahi hai.
Naya policy liya tha, ab treatment karana hai.
Date nikal gayi hai, ab bhi ho sakta hai kya?

check_claim_eligibility.purpose: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

check_inspection_requirement.purpose: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

lookup_policy.purpose: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

lookup_renewal_quote.purpose: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

register_claim.purpose: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

renew_policy.purpose: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

claim_intimation.purpose: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
claim_intimation.business_context: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

terminal_success_conditions: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.
Caller told why a claim cannot be registered and what would change that.
escalation_conditions: Caller alleges the insurer refused a claim wrongly on a previous occasion.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

policy_renewal.purpose: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.
policy_renewal.business_context: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

terminal_success_conditions: Policy renewed with a receipt number and the cover start date stated.
Caller told why renewal cannot complete on the call and what is needed.
escalation_conditions: Caller disputes the loading applied to their premium.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
